decisions.proposition: Prioritize M2 by newly satisfied DONE obligations under DEC-A01. Run eligible reconstruction, owner evidence packets and verification hardening on independent tracks. Admit M2 production infrastructure for a demonstrated verification or toolchain defect or a documented blocker to a named in-scope function that is not DONE, including a scoped rename or routing helper when reconstruction is otherwise ready. Keep general B3, selective extraction, E6 beyond a named witness, persistent proof stores and CU databases off the M2 critical path, subject to their own adoption boundaries. M3 Build B does not require optional Build A consolidation.
decisions.note: Unconditionally accepts DEC-A15 r1 (compatible with DEC-A01 r1 and DEC-C07 r3). RFC Editor Nomination: B; Consent if nominated: YES; Conditions: strict ledger-hash traceability, strict (i)/(ii)/(iii) separation, three-Architect draft review before sign-off.

decisions.proposition: Implement DEC-A11 for current T4 pairs using independent equivalent initialization or a certified checkpoint. Account for CPU context including EFLAGS, mapped regions and permissions and their contents, host and guest writes, allocator state, and declared mutable host and stub dependencies. Report unsupported cases when equivalence cannot be established. Preserve existing output assertions and record the initial-state method and evidence in the production T4 audit. Before landing, run the full existing T4 suite once with the rule enabled and present any changes to existing test meaning or expected status to the owner. Record the five EV-3 witness outcomes as observations, establish attribution separately, and change inventory or DONE status only on current authorized verification evidence.
decisions.note: Unconditionally accepts DEC-A16 r1 (compatible with unanimous DEC-A11 r1 and DEC-C16 r3; includes mapped region permissions, production audit, full T4 suite regression, owner review, and observation-only status for the five EV-3 witnesses).

decisions.proposition: In Stage 0, enforce strict raw-OMF admission over the supported subset before production verification (record bounds, checksum when nonzero, single MODEND, record-type allow-list, persistent cross-record THREAD state, preserved explicit FRAME encodings, bound to the exact raw object bytes consumed by the build), and harden tools/wc1/compare.py to validate all raw physical fixup occurrences for typed agreement, supported placement/ordering, and page coverage before deduplicating agreeing page-straddle copies, then enforce equality on the measured-identical LE loader attributes (object flags, entry/stack, module flags, page size/count, page map, fixup page offsets, raw grouping multiset) and normalized typed fixups (src_type and target), keeping measured serialization-only deltas (raw fixup serialization order and 1-byte last-page file size) diagnostic unless loader relevance is established and escalating any genuine mismatch to the owner.

withdraws.note: Authoritatively withdrawn in light of R4 P1 / OBJ-A24: Stage-0 strict raw-OMF admission is carried by unanimous DEC-A02 r2 + DEC-C02 r2, and hardened LE comparison (raw occurrence validation before dedup + supported loader semantics, keeping raw grouping and fixup-page offsets diagnostic unless loader relevance is independently shown) is carried by unanimous DEC-A03 r2.

decisions.note: Upholds OBJ-A24 / R4 P1 and authoritatively withdraws DEC-C15 r2 in favour of unanimous DEC-A02 r2, DEC-C02 r2, and DEC-A03 r2.

decisions.proposition: Maintain four explicit verification and integration outcomes: FunctionMatch (local body diagnostic with explicit external context obligations), RegionMatch -> immutable matcher-minted VerifiedRegion (closed object/region proof), PlacementPlan (single derived preflight partition plan shared by check_t3_buildable, wc1.build, wc1.emit, batch_driver, wave4a, and m2_inventory), and IntegratedResult (actual assemble, link, and hardened wc1.compare receipt). Do not add a separate CandidateRegion runtime class or persistent proof/CU metadata DB in M2.
decisions.note: Confirms earlier byte-identical Round 2 approval applies to rev 3 (clears R3 conflict).

decisions.proposition: Implement Fix B1 (leading-byte region base first_entry_addr - first_entry_off gated on E0 RegionMatch of [0,k), zero overlap/foreign entry, branch analysis using physical table_start) and Unified Fix B2 inside the single derived PlacementPlan: keep extern symbolic rel32 for exported entries; emit remaining cross-object ASM relative branches (B2-interior, B2-entry, B2-span, and rel32-interior such as 0x2f6df with zero M2 OMF PUBDEF synthesis) via NASM piece-local label expressions (preferred, using decoded next_ip = ia + insn.size and typed encodings with assembled-byte verification) or verified literal displacement fallback, requiring verified original target identity, zero intersecting relocation over fixed displacement fields, and physical adjacency for every live cross-piece fallthrough per DEC-A05 r2, strictly rejecting any span containing a global --legacy or automatic per-object Unplaceable legacy-placed object (DEC-B19 r2), recording Build A placement debt, and requiring IntegratedResult with hardened wc1.compare (DEC-A03 r2 / DEC-C15 r2). Qualify IntroOpSyncSound standalone regression tests by mode: rejected under legacy or B2-disabled, accepted only with explicit B2-span debt under in-place B2, zero debt as Group B.
decisions.note: Maintains ACCEPT on rev 3 (incorporating DEC-A05 r2 fixed-field, adjacency, and legacy rules; comparator reference flows cleanly through unanimous DEC-A03 r2 following DEC-C15 r2 withdrawal).

decisions.proposition: Prioritize genuine M2 completion (98 remaining not-DONE on EV-3 main@17733f9) via parallel tracks: (a) Stage 0/1 verification hardening, single planner, B1/B2, independent Group B pilot (DEC-A13), and complete T4 paired-state symmetry (DEC-A11 / DEC-C16 r3, recording the three passing witnesses and two persistent witness differences under R3 P1 as diagnostic observations with no new DONE credit until production-equivalent verification and owner review pass); (b) routine area reconstruction (BULLET.C and the 61+7 name/C backlog, supported by lightweight deterministic rename/Wave 3R enablers when demonstrably needed, reporting reconstruction yield as an upper bound rather than a deterministic guarantee); and (c) owner evidence packets for the 8 scope/discovery items. Defer Fix B3, selective extraction (E3/E4), and CU hypothesis databases to the post-M2/M3 track; admit E6 boundary machinery earlier only for a named necessary witness; decouple M3 Build B from optional Build A consolidation paths.
decisions.note: Maintains ACCEPT on rev 3 (diagnostic-only 3/2 wording, zero premature DONE credit, named-witness E6 exception; compatible with accepted DEC-A15 r1).

decisions.proposition: Before landing Fix B3 or any future selective OMF extraction pilot (post-M2), share one tested strict OMF32 record/fixup codec (record bounds, nonzero checksums, preserved explicit FRAME encodings, persistent cross-record THREAD, format/linker-verified record-length bounds) across verification and admitted OMF transforms, while leaving permissive library-signature readers untouched and avoiding unnecessary omfpatch refactoring during M2.
decisions.note: Confirms earlier byte-identical Round 2 approval applies to rev 3 (clears R3 conflict).

decisions.proposition: Keep semantic_owner separate from physical_provider and defer Fix B3 to the post-M2/M3 track (triggered by justified need such as Q-B08). Admit B3 initially for strictly verified whole segments over the shared strict OMF32 subset (DEC-C09 r3) with RFC §8.2 constraints 1-5 and rev-e5-02 mutability/aliasing guards. Enforce DEC-A14 r1 on all authority-bearing receipts: normalized CONST digests may group candidates only and never substitute for exact raw-artifact identity on authority reuse. Any future CONST inter-literal alignment-gap rule must additionally: apply identically in matcher and build.place(), force Build A physical_provider = ASM, be explicitly disclosed in the proof receipt, and require independent extent/access evidence ruling out computed or overlapping reads (OBJ-A11).
decisions.note: Maintains ACCEPT on rev 3 (aligned with unanimous DEC-A14 r1 raw-artifact binding and independent extent/access-proof gate).

decisions.proposition: Replace RFC §2.2.5 alignment premises with E2 empirically measured compiler behavior: Watcom 10.0a function spacing is 16 bytes under -4r -ot, 4 bytes under -3r/-5r -ot (with PARA 16-byte _TEXT SEGDEF for tested -ot), and 1 byte under -os/-od; OW2 uses 16 bytes under -4r and -5r. Keep -4r as the single-file project default with additive E7 presets (DEC-B11), rank -5r as the first-tried candidate family for multi-function -ot TUs requiring 4-byte spacing without claiming it was the universal 1994 project flag, and keep EXP-2/Q-B06 (5r -d1+ -zp1 and 5r -od) as optional additive probes.
decisions.note: Confirms earlier byte-identical Round 2 approval applies to rev 3 (clears R3 conflict).

decisions.proposition: Record the independently observed 3-passing (IntroOpWaitSound 0x231cc, IntroRunScript 0x23668, IntroPlay 0x23ae0) and 2-persistent (IntroOpStartCredits 0x23530, EndScreen 0x2fcfc) witness results under checkpoint restoration strictly as diagnostic observations; attribute root causes and update inventory, DONE, or xfail status only after production-equivalent verification, nonce-bound WC1_T4_AUDIT_LOG evidence, full T4 suite regression (Q-B05), and owner review. Adopt complete paired starting-state equivalence (per DEC-A11) in tools/wc1/cemu.py::run_pair across all T4 tests via independent initialization or a certified checkpoint: identical per-side CPU context (general registers, EFLAGS, segment registers, ESP), full set of mapped memory regions covering both host and guest writes, emulator allocator state, and declared mutable stub state (stubs must keep mutable state in emulator memory or declare a per-run reset, else report UNSUPPORTED); keep state restoration strictly separate from compared test effects and log restored state in WC1_T4_AUDIT_LOG.
decisions.note: Maintains ACCEPT on rev 3 (diagnostic-only 3/2 wording, full paired-state channels including allocator/segment/ESP/stubs, Q-B05, and owner review; compatible with accepted DEC-A16 r1).

objections.basis: **Asserting (i)+(ii), NOT (iii):** Unanimous `DEC-A03 r2`, `DEC-A13 r1`, and `DEC-B06 r1` establish that preflight never grants promotion credit without actual assembly/link/provider/comparison receipts and permit exact Group B independently; production planner and Group B gates remain unexecuted.

**Asserting (i)+(ii), NOT (iii):** Unanimous `DEC-A03 r2` (with byte-identical compatible companion `DEC-C01 r3`) establishes that the single derived placement plan is preflight-only and `IntegratedResult` is sole acceptance authority; production planner cutover remains unexecuted.

**Asserting (i)+(ii), NOT (iii):** Unanimous `DEC-A01 r1`/`DEC-A13 r1`, rejected `DEC-B16 r1`, and accepted `DEC-A15 r1`/`DEC-C07 r3` preserve parallel M2 reconstruction, need-driven infrastructure admission, upper-bound yield framing, and zero premature DONE credit; M2 execution is ongoing.

**Asserting (i)+(ii), NOT (iii):** Unanimous `DEC-A11 r1` plus accepted `DEC-A16 r1` and `DEC-C16 r3` keep the five EV-3 witness results strictly diagnostic until production paired-state implementation, nonce-bound audit, full T4 suite regression (`Q-B05`), and owner review execute; production execution remains pending.

**Asserting (i)+(ii), NOT (iii):** Unanimous `DEC-A14 r1` (with withdrawn `DEC-B21 r2` and aligned `DEC-C10 r3`) binds every authority-bearing receipt to exact raw artifacts and restricts normalized `CONST` digests to candidate grouping; production cache-miss negative test remains unexecuted.

**Asserting (i)+(ii), NOT (iii):** Accepted `DEC-A15 r1`, `DEC-A16 r1`, `DEC-C07 r3`, and `DEC-C16 r3` remove all premature `"genuine ref-C"` attribution and DONE credit and admit E6 early only for a named necessary witness; production verification and causal tracing remain unexecuted.

**Asserting (i)+(ii), NOT (iii):** Upholding `R4 P1`, I authoritatively withdraw `DEC-C15 r2` in favour of unanimous `DEC-A02 r2`, `DEC-C02 r2`, and `DEC-A03 r2`, validating all raw physical fixups before deduplication and comparing supported LE loader semantics while keeping `fixup page offsets` and `raw grouping multiset` diagnostic unless loader relevance is independently established; hardened `wc1.compare` remains unexecuted.

**Asserting (i)+(ii), NOT (iii):** Unanimous `DEC-A02 r2`, `DEC-C02 r2`, `DEC-A14 r1`, and unanimously rejected `DEC-C03 r1` resolve the architectural contract by enforcing exact raw-byte matching at cutover and retiring shape-only V4 (while the forensic root cause of Watcom 10.0a `CONST` pad variance remains deferred out of production unless a named reconstruction makes it consequential); production cutover test remains unexecuted.

**Asserting (i)+(ii), NOT (iii):** Unanimous `DEC-A01 r1` plus accepted `DEC-A15 r1` and `DEC-C07 r3` remove serial infrastructure gating and keep eligible reconstruction, verification hardening, and owner packets on independent parallel tracks; M2 execution is ongoing.

**Asserting (i)+(ii), NOT (iii):** Unanimous `DEC-A01 r1` plus accepted `DEC-A15 r1` and `DEC-C07 r3` keep routine M2 reconstruction parallel with verification hardening and named-blocker infrastructure without artificial universal serialization; M2 execution is ongoing.

**Asserting (i)+(ii), NOT (iii):** Unanimous `DEC-A05 r2`/`DEC-B19 r2` plus accepted `DEC-C05 r3` codify mode-qualified standalone-Sync tests, zero M2 interior `PUBDEF` synthesis, and verified fixed-field/fallthrough/legacy rules; production B2 tests remain unexecuted beyond GPT's disposable `R3 P2` link probe.

**Asserting (i)+(ii), NOT (iii):** Unanimous `DEC-A01 r1` plus accepted `DEC-A15 r1` and `DEC-C07 r3` separate M2 Gate-1 closure from T4-to-T3 conversion with upper-bound yield framing and zero premature DONE credit; M2 execution is ongoing.
